finding.claim: kmctl_search_files numbers lines with str.splitlines(), which also breaks on \r, \x0b, \x0c, \x1c-\x1e, \x85 and U+2028, while kmctl_read_file numbers lines by \n. In a file holding a form feed or a lone \r, search reports a different line number than read for the same line, and the auditor cites path:line from search as evidence.

fixes.change: Search splits lines on newline only, dropping a trailing carriage return, as kmctl_read_file counts them, so path:line evidence agrees.
A file with a form feed and a lone carriage return gives the same line number from search and read.
